Name: Nyapu's (unofficial) Portraits for Horny Bachelors
Author: HoneyKitten66
Description:
Edits of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11491]Nyapu's Portraits[/url]﻿ for Girafarig's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2564]Horny Bachelors[/url] mod.

Horny Bachelors & Valley Girls are two great mods that add some spice to the world of Stardew Valley.
Dasple made [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22274]Nyapu's Portraits and Custom Animations for Valley Girls[/url] & inspired me to make the equivalent for Horny Bachelors.


This mod can really be seperated into three parts.

[list=1]
[*][b]The first part[/b] is the NPCs with pleasure schedules.
The Bachelors: Alex, Elliott, Harvey, Same, Sebastian & Shane. As well as Demetrius, Kent & the Wizard.
Thanks to some help from [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/MangusuPixel/about-me]MangusuPixel[/url] I'm very happy with how all of these portraits turned out.
⠀
[*][b]The second part[/b] is for people who want to use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10844]Horny Festivals[/url]﻿ or enable [b]"let Lewis pass a law so the men of the town can be naked"[/b] in the config.
Some of these portraits aren't great... I'm not an artist and unlike the main characters who already had shirtless beach portraits, many of these needed to be made from scratch. That said I did make "something" for every character and & some of them turned out okay. The only portrait I did not attempt was Shane's "Fallen Down" portrait as it was beyond my skill set & rarely shows up.
⠀
[*][b]The third part[/b] is an [i]optional patch[/i] to twink the wizard.
When I first tried to nude the wizard, I just couldn't get it to look the way I wanted. So instead I downloaded & edited the sprites & portraits made by [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/lazytime111/about-me?gameId=1303]Lazytime111[/url]. They did an amazing job and I think the edits turned out quite well. However I do acknowledge that not everyone would want to make the wizard younger. So this is 100% optional. The NSFW Sprites were made with the help of [url=https://www.fiverr.com/martnpeadelarra]Martin P[/url]﻿.
[/list]If anyone wants to have a go at sorting Shane's "Fallen Down" or improve any of the other portraits please let me know or share them yourself.



[b]Requirements[/b]:
⠀• [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2564]Horny Bachelors[/url]﻿﻿﻿ ⠀⠀ (last checked on version 1.6.5)
⠀• [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11491]Nyapu's Portraits[/url]﻿﻿ ⠀⠀([b]XNB version only[/b])﻿



[b]Installation Instructions - HB Patch[/b]:
⠀• Download and install ﻿Horny Bachelors﻿﻿ and its requirements. (either the full version or the " - no bottles" version)
⠀• Download and unzip this mod into either "Mods\HB" or "Mods\HB - no bottles"
⠀• Overwrite all files when prompted.
⠀• [b]OPTIONAL:[/b] If you want to twink the wizard, download choose either the hatted or unhatted version and follow the same instructions.

[b]Installation Instructions - Nyapu XNB Version[/b]:
I don't understand why but but attempting to install the Nyapu Portraits using Content Patcher seems to get in the way of Horny Bachelors. Normally editing the manifest and adding a dependancy is enough, but that doesn't seem to help. As such this patch is only compatable with Nyapu's XNB version. You can find it in the Miscellaneous files near the bottom of the downloads. To install it follow these instructions:
⠀• Download the XNB version of Nyapu's Portraits
⠀• Extract all those files and put them in "Stardew Valley\Content\Portraits"
⠀• Overwrite all files when prompted.
[i][u]If you can find a way to make this work without using the XNB files please let me know.[/u][/i]

⠀• Download and unzip this mod into the HB folder
